nodes.label: loading01.png — Soybean SPA Loading Screen
nodes.summary: Documentation screenshot of the Soybean Admin SPA initial loading state. Shows a centered white-background layout with the purple/blue Soybean trefoil logo at top, an animated dot-ring loading indicator below the logo (4-5 dots in varying purple opacities arranged in a circle, suggesting a rotating animation frame), and the Chinese label 'Soybean 管理系统' (Soybean Management System) at the bottom. This is the pre-mount loading screen rendered by index.html / setupLoading() before the Vue app bundle takes over.

nodes.label: Soybean Trefoil Logo (visual element)
nodes.summary: Purple/blue rounded-stroke trefoil/三-petal mark — Soybean Admin brand identity. Appears at top-center of the loading screen as the primary visual anchor.

nodes.label: Dot-Ring Loading Spinner (visual element)
nodes.summary: Circular arrangement of ~5 purple dots with varying opacity, indicating a rotating loading animation. Placed below the brand logo as the activity-indicator. Consistent with CSS keyframe-animated dot-loader patterns commonly used in setupLoading() inline HTML.

nodes.label: Title Text — 'Soybean 管理系统'
nodes.summary: Bottom-centered grey sans-serif text reading 'Soybean 管理系统' (Soybean Management System, zh-CN). Identifies the product during the brief pre-mount window. Likely sourced from VITE_APP_TITLE or a hardcoded i18n string in the loading HTML.

nodes.label: Pre-Mount SPA Loading Screen (design pattern)
nodes.summary: Design rationale: SPAs have a noticeable blank-white gap between HTML load and Vue/React mount while the JS bundle is parsed and the first route resolves. Injecting a logo + spinner + title directly into index.html (via setupLoading() or equivalent) hides this gap with branded feedback, preventing the perception of a broken/blank page. The asset documents what this branded loading state looks like in Soybean Admin.

nodes.summary: Programmatic navigation trigger via Vue Router API.

nodes.label: 刷新 (Refresh)
nodes.summary: Browser refresh triggers full guard pipeline re-execution.

nodes.label: 地址栏回車 (Address bar enter)
nodes.summary: Direct URL navigation via address bar; full guard pipeline runs.

nodes.label: 路由守卫 (Route Guard)
nodes.summary: Outer guard wrapper: 开始 → 权限路由守卫 → 结束. Delegates to permission/auth route guard which dispatches to init + jump sub-flows.

nodes.label: 开始 (Start)
nodes.summary: Guard pipeline entry node.

nodes.summary: Central guard step orchestrating init flow then jump flow. Likely corresponds to createRouteGuard() in base-web router/guard/route.ts.
nodes.norm_label: 权限路由守卫 (permission route guard)

nodes.label: 结束 (End)
nodes.summary: Guard pipeline exit / next() called.

nodes.label: 路由初始化 (Route Initialization)
nodes.summary: Initialization sub-flow handling constant routes vs auth routes, not-found capture detection, login state check, and dynamic permission route generation.

nodes.label: 是否初始化了固定路由?
nodes.summary: Decision: have constant (fixed/static) routes been initialized? No → call 初始化固定路由 step; Yes → proceed.
nodes.norm_label: 是否初始化了固定路由?

nodes.label: 初始化固定路由 (Init Constant Routes)
nodes.summary: Loads static/constant routes that require no login.
nodes.norm_label: 初始化固定路由 (init constant routes)

nodes.label: 是否是not-found路由捕获? (first check)
nodes.summary: Decision: is current target the not-found capture route? Used early to skip auth processing for unmatched routes.

nodes.label: 是否是常量路由(无需登录权限)?
nodes.summary: Decision: is target a constant route requiring no auth? Yes → bypass auth checks.
nodes.norm_label: 是否是常量路由(无需登录权限)?

nodes.label: 是否初始化了权限路由?
nodes.summary: Decision: have permission (auth) routes been initialized? Drives dynamic route generation.
nodes.norm_label: 是否初始化了权限路由?

nodes.label: 是否是not-found路由捕获? (second check)
nodes.summary: Second not-found detection after auth-route check. AMBIGUOUS exact branching path (read 0.6).

nodes.label: 路由数据是否存在?
nodes.summary: Decision: does route data exist for target? No → next <=403 (forbidden).

nodes.label: next <=403
nodes.summary: Redirect to 403 forbidden page when route data missing.

nodes.label: 是否已登录?
nodes.summary: Decision: is user authenticated? No → next => login (force login page).

nodes.label: next => login
nodes.summary: Redirect unauthenticated user to login page.

nodes.label: 初始化权限路由 (Init Permission Routes)
nodes.summary: Dynamically generates and registers user's authorized routes (post-login).
nodes.norm_label: 初始化权限路由 (init permission routes)

nodes.label: 是否是not-found路由捕获? (third check)
nodes.summary: Third not-found check after permission route init — handles case where target was not-found before dynamic routes loaded but exists after.

nodes.label: 获取页面真实的初始路由 (Get real initial route)
nodes.summary: Resolves the real initial target route post-dynamic-load, then next <=真实.
nodes.norm_label: 获取页面真实的初始路由 (get real initial route)

nodes.label: next <= 真实 (next to real route)
nodes.summary: Re-navigate to the real resolved initial route after dynamic routes loaded.
nodes.norm_label: next <= 真实 (next to real route)

nodes.label: 路由跳转 (Route Jump)
nodes.summary: Jump/dispatch sub-flow run after init completes: handles redirects, login-page access while authenticated, forbidden targets, login required, permission required, custom redirects, fallback to previous route, and final execute-jump.

nodes.label: 开始 (Jump Start)
nodes.summary: Entry of jump sub-flow.

nodes.label: 已登录访问登录页?
nodes.summary: Decision: is authenticated user trying to access /login? Yes → redirect to root route.

nodes.label: 跳转根路由 (Jump to root)
nodes.summary: Redirect already-logged-in user away from login page to root.

nodes.label: 是否不允许访问? (Forbidden?)
nodes.summary: Decision: is the target disallowed for current user? Yes → jump to NF/forbidden. AMBIGUOUS exact label (0.5).

nodes.label: 直接跳转 (Direct jump to NF/403)
nodes.summary: Direct jump branch — likely 404/NF or 403 when access not allowed.
nodes.norm_label: 直接跳转 (direct jump to nf/403)

nodes.label: 是否需要登录?
nodes.summary: Decision: does target require login? Yes (and not logged) → jump to login route.

nodes.label: 跳转登录路由 (Jump to login route)
nodes.summary: Navigate to login page when authentication required.
nodes.norm_label: 跳转登录路由 (jump to login route)

nodes.label: 是否需要权限? (Need permission?)
nodes.summary: Decision: does target require role/permission user lacks? Yes → jump to 403.

nodes.label: 跳转403路由 (Jump to 403 route)
nodes.summary: Forbidden — user lacks required permission for target route.

nodes.label: 是否需要重定向? (Need redirect?)
nodes.summary: Decision: does target route have a custom redirect rule? Yes → direct jump.

nodes.label: 直接跳转 (Direct jump)
nodes.summary: Execute the redirect target directly.

nodes.label: 回到上一个路由 (Back to previous route)
nodes.summary: Fallback: return to previous route when no other rule matches.
nodes.norm_label: 回到上一个路由 (back to previous route)

nodes.label: 执行路由跳转 (Execute route jump)
nodes.summary: Final terminal action: call next() to commit navigation.
nodes.norm_label: 执行路由跳转 (execute route jump)

nodes.label: 说明 (Legend)
nodes.summary: Diagram legend: 固定路由 = routes not requiring login; 权限路由 = routes requiring login + permission; not-found 捕获 = when accessing a route not added to Vue Router, the not-found catch fires.

nodes.summary: VSCode launch.json 中的 TS Debugger 配置项，用于调试 TypeScript 源码（无需先编译为 JS）。截图中作为下拉选项出现在 Run and Debug 面板顶部，与项目根目录 .vscode/launch.json 中的 debug configuration 对应。

nodes.label: VSCode 调试面板 (Run and Debug)
nodes.summary: VSCode 左侧 Activity Bar 的 Run and Debug 面板，包含 变量(VARIABLES) / 监视(WATCH) 等子视图，是启动 Node/TS 调试会话的入口。截图中通过点击左侧带虫图标按钮切换到此面板。
nodes.norm_label: vscode 调试面板 (run and debug)

nodes.label: 断点 (Breakpoint) 设置示例
nodes.summary: 在编辑器行号槽点击添加断点（红色实心圆点）。截图示范在 debug.ts 第 11 行 `return result;` 处添加断点，调试器启动后会暂停于此行以检视 input/result 变量。

nodes.label: transformToKebabCase 示例代码
nodes.summary: 调试指南示例：debug.ts 中定义 transformToKebabCase(input: string): string，用 regex /([a-z])([A-Z])/g 替换为 '$1-$2' 后 toLowerCase；start() 用 'HelloWorld' 作为输入演示。仅作为调试目标，不属于业务逻辑。

nodes.label: VSCode 调试指南 截图 02
nodes.summary: VSCode 调试运行中的截图（指南第二张）：在 debug.ts 文件第 10 行 `console.log('result: ', result)` 命中断点，左侧 Run and Debug 面板展开 '变量' 与 '监视' 区段，显示 transformToKebabCase 与 start 函数的局部变量（input='HelloWorld'、result='hello-world'），右上角调试工具栏（继续/单步跳过/单步进入/单步退出/重启/停止）以红色箭头标注为 '调试选项'，演示 TS Debugger 配置下的实时变量观察能力。

nodes.label: VSCode 调试工具栏（调试选项）
nodes.summary: VSCode 调试期间顶部浮动工具栏：继续 (F5)、单步跳过 (F10)、单步进入 (F11)、单步退出 (Shift+F11)、重启 (Ctrl+Shift+F5)、停止 (Shift+F5)。截图以红色箭头与 '调试选项' 文字明确指向此区域，强调命中断点后的运行控制入口。
nodes.norm_label: vscode 调试工具栏(调试选项)

nodes.label: VSCode Variables 监视面板
nodes.summary: Run and Debug 侧栏的变量/监视区段，命中断点时按 scope（局部/闭包/全局）展开当前栈帧的变量值（如 input='HelloWorld'、result='hello-world'、this=undefined、transformToKebabCase 函数 prototype/Scopes 等），是 SDD/TDD 调试时验证运行时状态的核心 UI。

nodes.label: VSCode调试指南03.png
nodes.summary: VSCode debug guide screenshot #3 (third of series). Shows an active debugging session of a Vue/Naive UI project ('soybean-admin'). The left activity bar 'Run and Debug' panel displays the 'Vue Debugger' launch configuration running, with variables and watch panes visible. The editor shows an App.vue (or similar Vue SFC) source with a breakpoint set on a `console.log('About page mounted')` line inside an `onMounted(() => { ... })` hook — that line is highlighted as the current paused/executing line, with inline variable values shown next to it. Surrounding code includes pkgJson assembly (name, version, dependencies map via transformVersionData, BUILD_TIME constant) and a <template> block using NSpace/NCard layouts. The bottom-left 'Loaded Scripts' panel lists node_modules paths. Confirms full breakpoint-hit + variable inspection workflow inside Vue SFCs via the documented VSCode Vue Debugger launch config.

links.description: 总览章节引导读者进入快速开始流程
同步章节针对 fork 使用者，对应 intro 中分支策略
目录与 npm scripts 段落引用 sa CLI 命令
概述链接到详细命令清单
git-commit / git-commit-verify 命令在 hooks 阶段执行
useTable 示例中的 api 函数依赖 request 实例
原理章节引导到四式用法
SystemLogo 用 icon-local 本地 svg 机制
VITE_SERVICE_SUCCESS_CODE 与 App.Service.Response 配置
isBackendSuccess 依赖后端 code 约定
RequestOption 接口在 usage 实例中具体实现
代理基于 baseURL 与 env 配置
为支持 keep-alive 把多级路由转成二级
RouteMeta 与组件命名关联
命名规则在结构示例中展开
动态路由权限匹配发生在前置守卫
RouteMeta.constant / roles 字段是动态路由权限判断基础
路由总览引导到结构详解
routerPushByKey 依赖 RouteKey 类型
themeColor 来自 localStg、受 themeSettings 影响
主题原理在 settings.ts 配置中落地
setupLoading 中使用 systemLogo SVG 字符串
